capabilities: Force the backlinks panel's 'Show more context' toggle on
Automatically click 'show more above'/'show more below' chevrons a configurable number of times
Configure expansion levels, timing delays, and enable/disable per setting
extras: Relies on Obsidian's internal undocumented APIs (view.backlinks.backlinkDom) and may break on future Obsidian releases.
intentEvidence: giving you a Roam Research-style backlinks view
motivation: The author was inspired by a forum request for automatic context expansion in the backlinks view.
problem: Obsidian's backlinks panel shows matches collapsed, so users must manually click chevrons on every match to see the surrounding lines or bullets.
summary: Backlinks expansion plugin that automatically reveals surrounding context for each match in the backlinks panel, Roam Research-style, without manual clicking.
